later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: You're just talking about like, you know, outside of Salesforce when you're doing the reporting, you're seeing how the redeposit allocations are being uh spent against like what you're budgeting as a company. / Emily Vandenberg: Yes.

what_differs: WAGR-468 (created Sep 25, no comments, not updated) lists five asks. It does not state the payout-report rule from the same Sep 25 call (use actual deposit if completed, else expected), redeposit progress reporting (percent complete, player lists), over-budget alerts and total redeposit spend by type (assigned, immediate, personal), or that bet credit payouts count as redeposit spend by period and deal. It also does not say that company budget versus spend is reported outside Salesforce (L3349).
suggested_action: Suggest adding these items to WAGR-468's 'Requirements captured' list (with sources) so the financial reporting session starts from the full set.
